disease.name: Cardiovascular disease (CVD)
disease.full_name: Cardiovascular disease — composite category covering ischemic stroke, pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), aortic dissection / bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) with dilation, with framework architecture extensible to coronary heart disease, heart failure, and hypertensive heart disease in v0.2+.
disease.global_burden: Leading global cause of mortality (~17.9M deaths/year per WHO 2023). Ischemic heart disease and stroke are the top two causes of death worldwide.
disease.primary_sites: Heart, vasculature (endothelium, smooth muscle), brain (in stroke).

included_v0_1: I63 — Cerebral infarction (ischemic stroke; tested via VAL-108 GSE69138 3-subtype TOAST)
I27.0 — Primary pulmonary hypertension (tested via VAL-109 GSE84395 cultured PECs)
I27.2 — Other secondary pulmonary hypertension (heritable PAH covered by VAL-109)
I71 — Aortic aneurysm and dissection (tested via VAL-110 GSE84274 ascending aorta)
Q23.1 — Congenital insufficiency of aortic valve / bicuspid aortic valve with dilation (VAL-110 BAV+dilation arm)
deferred_to_v0_2: I20-I25 — Ischemic heart disease / coronary heart disease / MI
I05-I09 — Rheumatic / valvular disease (excluding BAV which is included)
excluded_for_clinical_distinctness: I00-I02 — Acute rheumatic fever (infectious etiology, distinct mechanism)
Q20-Q24 (excluding Q23.1) — Other congenital heart defects (developmental, distinct from acquired CVD)

cookbook_master_readme: README_MASTER_v2_3.md (current); v2_4 pending Phase 2 cookbook-wide CHK-3.1A/B split rollout.
validation_tier_rationale: VAL-108 + VAL-109 + VAL-110 tested cardio-epic across THREE independent public cohorts spanning THREE distinct substrates (GenomeStudio AVG_Beta whole blood, minfi preprocessFunnorm cultured PECs, GenomeStudio V2011.1 aortic tissue) and FOUR distinct cardiovascular pathologies (ischemic stroke 3-subtype, heritable PAH, idiopathic PAH, aortic dissection, BAV+dilation). VAL-109 demonstrated direct vascular-tile discrimination (Vascular_endothelial_cells d=+0.79 control vs hPAH on cultured PECs). VAL-110 demonstrated Stage 1 immune discrimination of aortic pathology (d=+1.08 normal vs BAV). VAL-108 documented the framework's correct null finding that whole-blood methylation does not stratify ischemic stroke etiology. The combined evidence supports a multi-modal validation tier — framework discriminates cardiovascular disease vs healthy on multiple substrates with biology-appropriate signal envelope, and correctly reports nulls where biology is homogenized.

validated_substrates.finding: Stage 1 d < 0.17 across all stroke etiology pairs — etiology-equivalent in whole blood (not a framework failure; biology-correct)
Stage 1 d = +0.65 control vs hPAH and control vs iPAH; strong PAH detection on cultured cells

stage_1_immune_flag.deployment_policy: Stage 1 immune A-score is the primary discriminator for cardio-epic across all validated substrates. Pure-cell substrates (PECs, cardiomyocyte) and bulk-tissue substrates (aorta) both show Stage 1 differentiation; whole-blood does not stratify etiology but does anchor the pooled inflammatory signature.

Cardio-epic v0.1 reporting filters non-cardio tile signals from bulk-aortic interpretation.

known_limitations.substrate_cell_mismatch_lesson: VAL-110 Vascular_endothelial_cells d=−0.04 on aortic bulk tissue vs VAL-109 d=+0.79 on cultured PECs is a substrate-cell-mismatch finding: framework reads what is in the sample. Pure cell type → pure cell signal. Mixed bulk tissue → mixed signal dominated by bulk's actual cell types (SMC + fibroblast for ascending aorta). Cardio-epic deployment must communicate the tile-substrate match to the customer.
known_limitations.biology_correct_nulls_documented: VAL-108 whole-blood stroke etiology equivalence is reported as a biology-correct null, not a framework failure. The framework correctly does not stratify what biology has homogenized.

card_specific: LL-CARDIO-001: Substrate-cell match matters. Vascular_endothelial_cells tile reads endothelial methylation when sample IS endothelial cells; reads SMC/fibroblast when sample IS bulk aorta. Cardio-epic deployment must communicate tile-substrate fitness to customers.

LL-CARDIO-002: Whole blood does not stratify stroke etiology. Post-stroke inflammatory homogenization is a real biological phenomenon. Cardio-epic v0.1 reports stroke as a single signature, not by TOAST etiology.
LL-CARDIO-003: hPAH > iPAH framework signal is consistent with germline genetic component. Future PAH cards may stratify by genetic vs idiopathic when biology supports.

LL-CARDIO-004: Aortic Stage 2 vascular tile fails on bulk tissue (cell mismatch); Stage 1 immune A-score is the strong aortic discriminator. The framework's stage-1 universal immune flag works on aortic tissue.
